meta.identity.title: App identity
meta.identity.remediation: If unresolved, make sure the input is a complete .app / IPA with an intact Info.plist.

meta.distribution.title: Distribution type
meta.distribution.remediation: Inferred only from embedded.mobileprovision, SC_Info and iTunesMetadata.plist; a re-signed package may differ from its original channel.

meta.permissions.title: Privacy permission declarations
meta.permissions.summary: {count} usage descriptions declared, {high_count} of high sensitivity: {high_keys}.
meta.permissions.remediation: Review high-sensitivity permissions against the app's purpose and check the stated reasons.

meta.fairplay_container.title: App Store FairPlay container
meta.fairplay_container.summary: {count} FairPlay-related files in SC_Info ({nested_units} nested units also carry SC_Info). This only shows the package came from App Store delivery; whether the binary is encrypted is decided by the Mach-O cryptid.
meta.fairplay_container.remediation: To analyse the binary, check cryptid; if it is encrypted, a decrypted IPA must be provided.

meta.signature_integrity.title: Code-signature resource seal check
meta.signature_integrity.summary: {checked} files checked: {missing} missing, {modified} modified, {extra} extra. A consistent seal does not prove authenticity (re-signed packages carry a fresh seal).
meta.signature_integrity.remediation: Missing or modified files mean the package was changed after signing (repackaging / injection).

meta.redaction.notice: Purchaser information was redacted ({count} fields); use --no-redact to keep it.
